mixed-parser-metrics.description: Ordered mixed-parser metrics, reusing the typed quality matrix queries.

shapes.name: explicit JSON then logfmt grouped count
shapes.query: sum by (user_id) (count_over_time({app=~"api-gateway-(storefront|billing|analytics|platform)",env="production",workload_scope="scope-01"} | json user_id="[\"user_id\"]" | logfmt | drop __error__, __error_details__ | user_id!="" [5m]))
shapes.original_matrix_query: sum by (user_id) (count_over_time({app="api-gateway",env="production"} | json user_id="[\"user_id\"]" | logfmt | drop __error__, __error_details__ | user_id!="" [5m]))
shapes.local_scope: Existing normal generator scope-01; broad workload remains failed and is not replaced by this result
